why: Charles Clifford albumen photograph of the Court of the Lions; clearly this building (catalogue date 'c. 1960' is surely wrong, Clifford worked 1850s-60s).
Historic albumen photograph of the hall's exterior, dome and entrance, sharp and clearly this building.
Early 20th c. photograph of the memorial across the water; low contrast but clearly the building.
Kip engraving (Britannia Illustrata, 1707): bird's-eye view of the hall and its gardens, clearly this house; a print, not an architect's drawing.

Burnham & Root drawings titled for the Rookery: LaSalle Street elevation (clear), elevation and section (damaged sheet, still readable), details sheet with plan/section pieces. Grille 146323 left out (ornament fragment).
Stieglitz 1903 photogravure 'The Flatiron': iconic early view; hazy and artistic, borderline.
Opus: Adler & Sullivan working drawings of this building (pilaster details with section; lobby details on a plan arc).
